description.zh: 提供 21 种版式和 22 种视觉风格，会先读内容再给出推荐搭配，然后产出可直接发布的信息图。适合把报告、文章浓缩成一页大图。生成图片需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Picks a layout from 21 types and a style from 22 options after reading the content, then renders a publication-ready infographic. Good for compressing reports or articles into one tall image. Needs an image generation backend.
